briefdescription.para: Standalone log / exp / Zech-table scratch file for Z/p at p = 101, not part of the build.

detaileddescription.para: Hardcodes the discrete-log and exponential tables of (Z/101)^* (the primitive root generates the multiplicative group, so each index i in [0, p-1) stores g^i mod p in exp_table[i] and inversely in log_table), keeps a second variant with the zero/one boundary adjusted (exp_table2 / log_table2), and pastes the subtract_multiple inner-loop body from aring-zzp.hpp next to them. The intent was to ship a self-contained example to Compiler Explorer (godbolt) and inspect the generated assembly for the table-based modular arithmetic. CMake / autotools exclude this file from the production build; the tables are not consulted at runtime.
Retain as a worked-example reference for anyone adding a new small Z/p aring; the production paths live in aring-zzp.hpp, aring-zzp-flint.hpp, and aring-zzp-ffpack.hpp.
